text: Awesome cleaning service at our doorstep.

name: Simran Rajput
text: I had a great experience with their dry cleaning service. The quality of work is excellent, and my clothes came back looking fresh and well-finished. What I really liked is that their pricing is quite reasonable compared to other options in the market. Overall, best service at an affordable cost. Highly recommended!

name: Akash
text: Excellent service by Apparel Clinic. My kurta had stains and needed proper care, and their dry cleaning process restored it very well. The finishing and garment handling were professional. Highly recommended for garment care.
